prompt: Announce the neighborhood's annual garage sale as a WWE championship ladder match. Everything must go.
response:
**(Cue explosions, strobe lights, and heavy metal entrance music)**

LADIES AND GENTLEMEN! 

Welcome to the most brutal, high-stakes, bargain-busting spectacle in the history of the subdivision! This Saturday morning, the cul-de-sac transforms into the squared circle for the **OAK CREEK NEIGHBORHOOD ANNUAL GARAGE SALE SLAM!**

That’s right! We are bypassing the steel cage, we are ignoring the Royal Rumble, and we are going straight to a **TRIPLE-THREAT CHAMPIONSHIP LADDER MATCH OF SAVINGS!** 

Look up! Hanging twenty feet above the pavement, right next to the Miller’s oak tree, is the undisputed, heavyweight title of BARGAINS! And the only way to claim it is to climb the rungs of a gently used, aluminum Werner step-ladder—priced to move at just fifteen bucks! 

**EVERYTHING MUST GO!** And I mean *EVERYTHING!* 

We are laying the smackdown on clutter! We are taking vintage Pyrex dishes and putting them in a devastating figure-four leglock of discounts! 
We are grabbing outgrown baby clothes, picking them up, and POWERBOMBING them into the discount bin! 
BAH GAWD, THAT TUPPERWARE SET HAS A FAMILY! But it doesn't matter, because it’s getting suplexed straight into your trunk for a dollar fifty!

Listen to me! The HOA says we have until 2:00 PM, but we are not stopping until the driveway is cleared! If a piece of inventory is left standing by the time the bell rings, I swear as God is my witness, it will be thrown through the Spanish announce table! 

**THE RULES ARE SIMPLE:**
1. No holds barred!
2. Cash is king! (Venmo accepted upon referee's discretion).
3. If you see a slightly scuffed mahogany end table, you better tag-team your spouse and load it into your minivan before the Robinsons from down the street hit you with a steel chair!

**WHEN:** This Saturday! Bell time is 7:00 AM SHARP! Early birds will be hit with a Stone Cold Stunner! 
**WHERE:** 1428 Elm Street Driveway—The Grandest Stage of Them All!

Bring your trucks, bring your muscle, and bring your championship spirit. BECAUSE EVERYTHING MUST GO, AND THAT’S THE BOTTOM LINE! 

**(Cue dramatic glass shatter and fade to black)**
